text: I do, although I wouldn't call myself an expert. I'm drawn to modern photography and street art more than classical paintings, probably because they feel closer to everyday life. There are some brilliant murals in Almaty now, and I often stop to look at them on my way home.

tips.en: A yes with a modest note sounds natural.
tips.kk: Иә — сарапшы емеспін деген ескертпемен: табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Да — с оговоркой, что не эксперт: звучит естественно.
tips.example: I wouldn't call myself an expert

tips.en: More than and probably because give a taste and its reason.
tips.kk: More than және probably because — талғам және оның себебі.
tips.ru: More than и probably because — вкус и его причина.
tips.example: more than classical paintings, probably because they feel closer to everyday life

questions.followUp: What kind of art do you like best?
questions.question: Do you like art?

text: Yes, a few times. The one that stuck with me was the Kasteyev Museum in Almaty, which has a huge collection of Kazakh paintings and applied art. I went on a school trip and found it boring then, but when I went back last year on my own, I spent nearly three hours there.

tips.en: The museum's name and what it holds make the answer precise.
tips.kk: Мұражайдың атауы және онда не бар екені — жауап дәл.
tips.ru: Название музея и что в нём есть — ответ точный.
tips.example: which has a huge collection of Kazakh paintings

tips.en: Bored then, three hours now — a mini-story in one answer.
tips.kk: Сол кезде жалықтырды — қазір үш сағат: бір жауаптағы шағын оқиға.
tips.ru: Скучно тогда — три часа сейчас: мини-история в одном ответе.
tips.example: I spent nearly three hours there

questions.followUp: Would you like to go more often?
questions.question: Have you ever been to an art gallery?

text: I loved it. I used to cover every spare page of my school notebooks with little cartoons, which my teachers weren't thrilled about. I gave it up as a teenager when I got busier, but recently I've started sketching again in the evenings — it's surprisingly relaxing.

tips.en: The detail about notebooks and teachers shows the love of drawing better than just saying so.
tips.kk: Дәптер мен мұғалімдер туралы дерек сурет салуға құмарлықты «жақсы көрдім» дегеннен жақсы көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Деталь про тетради и учителей показывает любовь к рисованию лучше слова «любил».
tips.example: cover every spare page of my school notebooks with little cartoons

tips.en: Three time frames in one answer show good grammatical range.
tips.kk: Бір жауапта үш шақ — жақсы грамматикалық ауқым.
tips.ru: Три времени в одном ответе — хороший грамматический диапазон.
tips.example: I gave it up as a teenager

questions.question: Did you enjoy drawing when you were a child?

text: Not much, to be honest. We've got a couple of framed prints in the living room and a small painting of horses in the steppe that my uncle bought from a local artist. It isn't famous or valuable, but it reminds me of summers in the countryside, so it's probably my favourite thing in the flat.

tips.en: What it shows, who bought it and from whom — several details in one sentence.
tips.kk: Не бейнеленген, кім және кімнен сатып алған — бір сөйлемде бірнеше дерек.
tips.ru: Что изображено, кто купил и у кого — несколько деталей в одной фразе.
tips.example: a small painting of horses in the steppe that my uncle bought from a local artist

tips.en: Not valuable but important — a concession with but and a result with so.
tips.kk: Қымбат емес, бірақ маңызды — but арқылы мойындау, so арқылы қорытынды.
tips.ru: Не дорогая, но важная — уступка через but и вывод через so.
tips.example: It isn't famous or valuable, but it reminds me of summers

questions.question: Is there any art in your home?

text: Yes, definitely, even if most students won't become artists. Art lessons teach you to notice details and to solve problems in a creative way, which is useful in almost any job. It's a shame that in many schools art gets cut first whenever there's pressure to improve exam results.

tips.en: Even if deals with the obvious objection straight away.
tips.kk: Even if «суретші болмаса, не керек» деген айқын қарсылықты бірден жояды.
tips.ru: Even if сразу снимает очевидное «зачем, если не станут художниками».
tips.example: even if most students won't become artists

tips.en: A practical benefit, then It's a shame to evaluate the situation.
tips.kk: Практикалық пайда, сосын It's a shame — жағдайға баға.
tips.ru: Практическая польза, затем It's a shame — оценка ситуации.
tips.example: It's a shame that in many schools art gets cut first
